title: gaga arizonica
intro: Gaga arizonica, commonly known as Arizona globe-mallow or Arizona mallow, is a flowering plant species in the mallow family, Malvaceae. It is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Gaga arizonica include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
